Subject: Slate Ventures — cohort promo bundle request

Hi Marcus,

I'm putting together the benefit package for our winter founder cohort (Slate Ventures, cohort starting Jan 2027) and wanted to see if Redwood can provide a tailored promo bundle. Typical usage for the cohort is ~120M tokens across 12 companies during a 3-month window — primarily embeddings + moderate chat usage during demo days.

What we're hoping for: 1) an up-front promo credit to cover initial ramp, 2) a short-term reserved discount or committed usage rate for month 1 to ensure latency during peak days, and 3) some lightweight co-marketing (logo + a short blurb).

Is this something your team can help with? If helpful I attached a one-pager with cohort expectations. We have a tight timeline and would like to lock terms before Dec 10.

Thanks,

Slate Ventures

Hi Ari — great to hear from you and congrats on the upcoming cohort. We can absolutely put together a package that fits this use case. Initial thought (subject to internal approval):

- Promo credit: $10,000 applied to your account upfront to cover ramp.
- Reserved/committed discount: 30% off Dedicated/reserved capacity for the first 30 days (so you get predictable latency during peak demo days).
- Co-marketing: yes — we'll provide a short case blurb and include Slate Ventures in our startup partner page.

I attached a promo matrix outlining standard accelerator bundles we typically offer. If you need more credits or a longer discount window, let me know how far we need to push and I'll see what exceptions we can request.

Timing-wise we can get a simple term sheet over by early next week if you confirm.

Best,
